body: ASSIGNMENT — implement the volunteered P1 overflow remedy on exactly align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/cost.scala and align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/CostSuite.scala. Acceptance: CostWeights.of must reject a non-representable aggregate finite/nonnegative weight vector with typed AlignError.InvalidConfig; replace ratio-then-multiply arithmetic so extreme representable partial-support cases do not manufacture nonfinite intermediates; preserve the current full-support raw weighted sum bit-identically when present equals eligible; add full-support, partial-support, aggregate-refusal, near-boundary, and GraphHsmm checked-constructor-before-probability controls; mutation controls must kill removal of the aggregate check and restoration of ratio-then-multiply. Do not absorb FunctionPrior, introduce public vocabulary, or touch a third path. Work from a standalone clone, claim and reserve the exact paths, run scalafmtCheckAll plus the exact cross-platform gate emitted by tools/reference-scope.sh using the merge base and candidate in the clone checked out at the candidate. Register a candidate with receipt and SHA evidence; no authorization, landing, full testAll, or bead close.
